question: Which of the following satellites was operated by the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jugnu**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jugnu** was a satellite operated by the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur.
 
• It was a nano-satellite developed by the students and faculty of IIT Kanpur.
 
• The satellite was launched by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) on October 12, 2011.
 
• Jugnu was designed to demonstrate technologies for imaging and data transmission.
 
• The satellite's mission was to collect data related to agriculture and disaster monitoring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur (IIT Kanpur) is one of the premier institutions in India, known for its engineering and technological research and education.
 
• ISRO frequently collaborates with educational institutions to foster innovation and research in space technology.
 
• Jugnu was part of ISRO's initiative to encourage academic institutions to participate in space missions and satellite development.
 
• Such collaborations help in building the technical skills and research capabilities of students, preparing them for future challenges in space technology.
